description: This Java source file defines the RitaApi class, which facilitates communication with a third-party payment processing system via HTTP. It includes request and response field constants, methods for setting and retrieving data, and logic for sending requests and parsing responses.

classes.name: RitaApi
classes.description: A class providing methods to configure, send, and parse responses from a third-party payment system via HTTP. It manages request and response data, configuration for server connection, and validation of fields.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Sets a value for a specified field in the request document after validating its legality and converting it to a string.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves the value of a specified field from the response document after validation.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Serializes the current document map into a string format suitable for transmission.

methods.name: getDocument
methods.description: Returns the internal map representing request or response data.

methods.name: send
methods.description: Sends the request to the configured server and processes the response, returning a new RitaApi instance with response data.
